PREMISE DISPROVEN — DROP. Core claim 'perpetual spinner forever, no timeout' is FALSE: bootstrap.js:23 sets window.axios.defaults.timeout=30000, so a hung POST /frontend/order REJECTS after 30s into confirmPayment's catch which clears submitting and surfaces error — NOT perpetual. The finding self-defeats by admitting 'no escape except the inactivity reset' — that reset exists (KioskAppComponent.vue:898 idleTimer fires regardless of screen), so recovery is guaranteed. Cited lines (30-48 spinner, 421, 770) exist (file_line_exists:true) but the 'stuck forever' defect does not. At most a P3 nit about a 30s wait lacking a progress hint — but as written (perpetual, no escape) is_real:false, DROP.
